item.title: Shoots
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
PORTRAITURE, REIMAGINED

Celebrity style sessions are the new normal.

SELF-CARE, REIMAGINED

There’s something pretty incredible about having an entire day that’s just about you. Champagne, professional hair and makeup, beautiful clothes, and a creative team focused on making you look and feel amazing. It’s part photoshoot, part escape, and a little bit of an indulgence. And honestly, that’s exactly what it’s supposed to be. Maybe that’s why so many of my clients come back and do it all over again.

WHY IS THIS DIFFERENT FROM OTHER PORTRAIT SESSIONS?

This isn’t a show up, take a few pretty pictures, and head home kind of shoot. We plan everything together, from what you’ll wear to the hair, makeup, lighting, and overall direction of each look. And once you’re in front of my camera, I’ll guide you through every bit of it.

Most of my clients aren’t models. They’re women who want beautiful photographs of themselves, whether they’re celebrating something, stepping into a new chapter, or simply deciding it’s finally time to do this for themselves. My style is fashion-inspired, polished, and editorial, but the images should still feel unmistakably like you. If that sounds like what you’ve been looking for, you can read what past clients have shared about their experience here.

WHAT IS INCLUDED IN MY PORTRAIT SESSION?
Everything you need to feel prepared, look incredible, and actually enjoy the experience:
- a planning consultation with me
- a custom styling mood board
- a 4-hour photoshoot with 3–4 looks
- champagne in the studio
- professional hair + makeup with touchups throughout your shoot
- access to my studio wardrobe
- complete posing and expression guidance from me
- my signature retouching on every image you purchase
- a private Reveal to see your images and choose your favorites

WHAT SHOULD I WEAR?
We’ll figure that out together! Before your shoot, we’ll talk through the overall look and feel you want, and I’ll help you choose pieces that photograph beautifully and still feel like you. Once you’re booked, I’ll create a custom mood board with ideas for your specific shoot, including silhouettes, textures, colors, and places to shop. You’ll also have access to my studio wardrobe of gowns, bodysuits, and accessories.

HOW DOES THE PRICING WORK?
Your session fee is due when you book and reserves your date and creative team. Your portraits are purchased separately at your Reveal, after you’ve seen your images and know exactly what you love. For full pricing and collection details, simply fill out the contact form and we’ll send everything over.

WHAT IS YOUR AVAILABILITY LIKE?
I only take a limited number of shoots each month so I can be very hands-on with every client, from planning through the final edits. My calendar does tend to fill in advance, so if you have a particular date or timeframe in mind, I recommend reaching out early.

behind the scenes with Emily Travis of Champagne & Chanel

The best kind of text to get! This will never get old. xx

I’M NERVOUS. IS THIS REALLY FOR SOMEONE LIKE ME?
Yes. And I promise, almost everyone is nervous at first.
The women you see throughout my portfolio are real clients, not professional models. You do not need to know how to pose, what to do with your hands, or how to make the right expression. That’s my job. I’ll guide you through all of it throughout the shoot so you never have to wonder what you’re supposed to be doing. Just show up. We’ll take care of the rest.

WILL YOU PHOTOSHOP OR RETOUCH MY IMAGES?
Yes. Every portrait you purchase receives my signature retouching and the same polished, editorial finish you see throughout my portfolio. I want you to look like the very best version of yourself, while still looking like you.

WHAT IF I ONLY WANT DIGITALS?
Digitals and printed portraits are the same price. You’re investing in the creation of the image itself, rather than the format you choose to receive it in. Every portrait you purchase includes the corresponding digital file.

HOW DO YOU DESIGN THE LOOKS?
It all starts with the wardrobe. Once we decide what you’re wearing, I build everything else around it, including the hair, makeup, backdrop, and lighting. Every detail works together to create the final image. If you have inspiration you love, send it my way! I love seeing what you’re drawn to, and we can use that as a starting point while still making the shoot feel completely your own.

WHAT KIND OF PRODUCTS DOES THE STUDIO OFFER?
At your Reveal, you’ll see approximately 150 of the best images from your shoot and choose the portraits you love most. From there, your selections receive my signature retouching and can be enjoyed digitally or as finished artwork. The studio offers coffee-table albums, framed wall art, and beautiful print options including matted prints, canvas, and metal. We’ll help you choose what makes the most sense for your images, your home, and how you actually want to enjoy them.

FAQ’S

WILL I REALLY LOOK AS POLISHED AS THE WOMEN ON YOUR SITE?

Yes! Every woman you see on my site is a real client. The lighting, styling, posing, hair and makeup, and retouching all play a part in creating the finished images you see. You don’t need to arrive knowing how to pose or somehow magically be photogenic. That’s what I’m here for.

WHAT IF I ONLY WANT DIGITALS?

Digitals and printed portraits are the same price. You’re investing in the creation of the image itself, rather than the format you choose to receive it in. Every portrait you purchase includes the corresponding digital file.

DO YOU PHOTOGRAPH EXTENDED FAMILIES?

I don’t offer extended family sessions. My work is focused on individuals and couples and is much more fashion-inspired and editorial than traditional family photography.

DO YOU TRAVEL?

I photograph all of my sessions in my St. Louis studio, but many of my clients travel in to work with me. The studio is about 30 minutes from the airport.

WHAT SHOULD I WEAR?

We’ll figure that out together! Once you’re booked, I’ll create a custom mood board for your shoot with styling ideas, outfit inspiration, and suggestions for where to shop. You’ll also have access to my studio wardrobe.

HOW MUCH RETOUCHING IS INCLUDED?

Every portrait you purchase includes my signature retouching and the same polished, editorial finish you see throughout my portfolio. The goal is always for you to look incredible, but still completely like yourself.

HOW MANY LOOKS WILL I HAVE DURING MY SESSION?

We typically photograph 3–4 different looks, and they absolutely don’t have to feel the same. You might want something glamorous, something sexy, something simple and timeless, or something a little unexpected. We’ll plan each look together so you get plenty of variety while the final collection still feels like you.

I’M NERVOUS. IS THIS REALLY FOR SOMEONE LIKE ME?

Absolutely. Most of my clients are nervous when they walk in.

You don’t need to know how to pose. You don’t need to practice expressions in the mirror. And you definitely don’t need to walk in feeling wildly confident in front of a camera. I’ll guide you through every pose and expression from beginning to end.

All you have to do is show up. I’ve got the rest.

item.content:encoded:
GETTING THAT PERFECT SHOT IS MY JOB.
I’VE TRESPASSED, STOPPED TRAFFIC, SHIMMIED UNDER BARBED WIRE, SCARED OFF A RATTLESNAKE,
SCALED THE OUTSIDE OF A FOUR-STORY BUILDING, AND HUNG BY MY ANKLES OFF A BOAT.

MY NAME IS JADE HA AND I’M A PHOTOGRAPHER.

I'm a portrait & fashion photographer, a retoucher and an educator—and I’ve spent my career creating beautiful photographs of women. My work is sensual, fashion-inspired, and a little Vanity Fair, with a team that takes care of everything from hair and makeup to styling, posing, and the final edits. Every shoot starts with you, what you love, what you’re drawn to, and how you want to see yourself. From there, we create something together that feels beautiful, polished, and like you on your very best day.

item.title: Meet The Team
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Jade Ha - Photographer & Retoucher

Hi, I’m Jade! I’ve been photographing women for more than a decade, and I still love that every shoot gives us the chance to create something completely different. I’m incredibly hands-on, obsessed with the details, and I’ll guide you through every pose and expression so you never have to wonder what to do in front of the camera. I want your day to feel creative, collaborative, and entirely too much fun. I can’t wait to work with you!

Karen - Booking Concierge

Hi! I’m Karen and I’m here to walk you through the process of planning your luxe portrait experience. I will keep you on point to make sure every detail is covered, so your day of pampering can be just that. Looking forward to working with you and seeing your gorgeous photos soon!

Lauren - Shoot Assistant

Hey friends! I'm Lauren, and I can't wait to assist you during your shoot. I'll be there to make the day fun, comfortable, and provide help to you and Jade any way I can to elevate your entire experience. (I’m also a videographer, so don't mind me while I capture some beautiful behind the scenes footage for you!) I'm so excited for the opportunity to work with you while Jade creates beautiful moments that will last a lifetime!
